text_block_list.text:
I check on Cesario after finishing 
treating her injury.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. However, there is no 
need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: There's nothing to worry about at all.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...I suppose I really can't hide anything 
from you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
However, it doesn't hinder my movement. I 
will return to training immediately.
choice_data_list:
If a future student of yours said that... 
would you accept it?

We're dialing back the workout intensity. 
That's my condition.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: That's an unfair way of putting it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
However... a few days of rest versus the 
risk of worsening. The choice that should 
be made is the former, I presume.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I will be taking a brief rest. I shall 
return in top form, so please pardon my 
absence.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes. That is fine with me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Hmph...! Hmph...! Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Ow!?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ngh... I pushed the pace way too hard.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It seems... that was a rather expensive 
lesson to learn.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
While the result is regrettable... an 
experience like this will surely prove 
useful down the road.

It seems that overexerting her workload 
has worsened her injury...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Hah...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Phew!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes. If it's just this much.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm holding back on the 
contents, I want to at least maintain it 
enough so my skills don't deteriorate.

Cesario switched to a lighter regimen and 
returned to her regular training routine 
in a short period of time.
